name: simple-report
description: Single column prose with a running head, running foot, and page numbers that must stay out of the reading stream.

name: two-column
description: Academic shape: a title and abstract spanning the page over two columns that begin underneath it.

name: three-column-news
description: Three narrow columns under a spanning masthead, with headings inside the columns.

name: justified-kerned
description: One justified column whose slack is spread as per-gap TJ kerns - the LaTeX and InDesign shape. Wide inter-word gaps are what a naive gutter detector mistakes for a column break.

name: justified-wordspaced
description: The same justified column, stretched with a Tw word-spacing value instead - the shape Word emits.

name: nested-lists
description: Bulleted and numbered lists at two depths, between prose - each item its own block, never folded into the paragraph above.

name: table-ruled
description: A bordered table read row-major, between prose.

name: table-borderless
description: The same table with no rules at all - columns held apart by whitespace, which is what makes a borderless table read as parallel columns of prose.

name: figures-captions
description: Raster and vector figures with captions. The vector figure is the interesting one: the reading view surfaces image XObjects only, so artwork drawn as paths disappears from the reflow.

name: footnotes
description: Body text over a separator rule with small-type footnotes, which belong after the page body and not inside the paragraph that happens to sit above them.
